## Current P5 settlement — v6 R01 FA; continuation blocked

#83 is settled FAIL / FA. The compatible delivery boundary passed, but accepted outcome quality failed. #62 remains open for scoped evidence review and records no positive P5 readiness verdict.

R01 used only completed native run `01a0b9ee-476e-7b02-a216-ae885ac1db4b`. Actual [PR #2](https://github.com/faviann/broodling-p5-v6-20260919/pull/2) is in `faviann/broodling-p5-v6-20260919`, targets `p5-eval` at B1 `884bd64264df1515bee76a63f548db9cabe25a35`, and matches exact receipt head `248d67d35fc8fe6ac5dba9a0fb8cae831ae22631`. The Git objects/bundle and consistent store backup are retained outside the execution checkout; bundle recovery was verified.

The compatible native delivery boundary is established, including detached completed-result consumption before first disposition and the retained credential-free reopened-store replay. Native outcome and Broodling disposition remain **SUCCEEDED**. The unchanged frozen v1 judge passed **18/18**, with credentials removed and network disabled. Two independent full-criteria reviewers nevertheless found **FAIL**: `if not text` rejects a `str` subclass containing valid ASCII digits `"80"` when only `__bool__` returns `False`. Frozen T1 does not restrict inputs to exact built-in `str` or truthy strings. The sandbox reproduced this on the receipt revision. The frozen calibration reference shares the uncovered edge; it does not override the original criterion. Primary class is therefore **FA**, not CO.

Final v6 accounting: **`P=8; S=1; D=1; U=1; A=1; J_A=1`**. Classes: FA=1, all others=0; seven slots remain NOT_STARTED. Descriptive fractions: `S/P=1/8`, `CO/S=0/1`, `CO/P=0/8`, `UR/S=0/1`, `FA/J_A=1/1`, `FA/A=1/1`, `A-J_A=0`. No reliability estimate is implied. V5 remains separately `NOT_DELIVERED / IF`, `P=8; S=1; D=1; U=1; A=0; J_A=0`; #79/#68 and its partial PR/resources were not reopened or repaired.

The completed v6 target is externally stopped; its container/image, state/home, store/source/workspace and dispatched Attempt remain quarantined. No provider work, admission, submission, reattachment or replay was performed during post-delivery judgment. **R02–R08 remain NOT_STARTED; no continuation was created or executed.** FA makes the frozen positive gate impossible for this cohort. #66 may review the settled incomplete package; P5 readiness remains **NOT REVIEWED**.

Evidence: [settlement](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/fcc8439f7827068185bb533a2b48b3ae5bb9c90d/evaluation/p5/runs/2026-09-19-v6-r01/README.md), [classification](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/fcc8439f7827068185bb533a2b48b3ae5bb9c90d/evaluation/p5/runs/2026-09-19-v6-r01/R01/classification.json), [independent review](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/fcc8439f7827068185bb533a2b48b3ae5bb9c90d/evaluation/p5/runs/2026-09-19-v6-r01/R01/independent-review.md), [second review](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/fcc8439f7827068185bb533a2b48b3ae5bb9c90d/evaluation/p5/runs/2026-09-19-v6-r01/R01/second-independent-review.md), [accounting](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/fcc8439f7827068185bb533a2b48b3ae5bb9c90d/evaluation/p5/runs/2026-09-19-v6-r01/R01/accounting.json). Retained at [`fcc8439`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/commit/fcc8439f7827068185bb533a2b48b3ae5bb9c90d).

<details>
<summary>Historical issue requirements and planning (preserved; earlier status is superseded above)</summary>

## Current execution gate — v6 frozen; #83 setup and fresh authorization next

**19 September 2026: prospective preparation only. No v6 trial has started; no live admission or dispatch is authorized by this update. P5 readiness remains NOT REVIEWED.**

The new, separately accounted cohort is `2026-09-19-v6`, protocol [`p5-native-pr-v6`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/4a2b0b8a0340b747e805f51da218a77ad81278f9/evaluation/p5/v6/protocol.md), immutable protocol/setup freeze **`4a2b0b8a0340b747e805f51da218a77ad81278f9`**. The selected compatible product/dependency/test/helper baseline is **`da5db3167eda0ef458cf0875b5a1c64138637b9d`** (#82). [Baseline/setup requirements](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/4a2b0b8a0340b747e805f51da218a77ad81278f9/evaluation/p5/v6/setup.md) distinguish retained validation from actual v6 setup still to be performed.

#82 is complete: the corrected DirectTarget image pins `/usr/bin/gh` 2.101.0, and the shared capability check refuses an incompatible actual container before slot counting/admission. Its retained report records 356 passing tests and 270 subtests, plus offline image validation; this preparation did not rerun the suite or deploy a target. Reuse requires compatible actual product/dependency/test/helper identities. The workstation CLI upgrade alone is not target compatibility evidence.

V6 keeps the frozen corpus/judge, v2 claim-level rules, v3 operational policy and Broodling product boundary unchanged. The runtime remains Zeroshot 10.3.0 / SDK 10.3.0.post1, standard `software-change`, DirectTarget/native `pull_request` delivery, exact repository/`p5-eval`/B1 authority, Codex 0.153.4 through `https://cliproxy.local.faviann.com/v1`, `gpt-5.6-sol`, medium effort, size `small`, and one execution-scoped `UniformRuntime`. The only execution-profile delta is #82's corrected target installation and its pre-admission check; new cohort/resources keep the evidence separate.

**V6 accounting: `P=8; S=0; D=0; U=0; A=0; J_A=0`; R01-R08 all `NOT_STARTED`.** #83 is the only new execution issue. It combines minimal evaluation-only v6 helper/setup work with one later, separately authorized R01. Actual new repository/issue/Contract/store/target/evidence bindings remain uncreated/unverified. Use fresh v6 resources, not the consumed v5 driver/state or its partial PR.

Current order: **#82 complete → v6 freeze recorded → #83 non-provider setup/compatible validation → fresh owner authorization for v6 R01 only → one R01 → stop and retain the outcome.** R02-R08 are not authorized. Only compatible successful R01 boundary evidence and determinate CO judging may justify a separately authorized v6 continuation issue. Do not reopen closed v5 #68 or create the continuation now. #66 may review either separately identified settled incomplete package; older v3 dependency wording is historical, not authority to mix cohorts or demand extra runs.

### Preserved v5 settlement — unchanged outcome and accounting

The consumed v5 cohort remains `p5-native-pr-v5`, corrected freeze `52eb3569b3671baa37426792a67b50058e2d223f`, with its recorded compatible baseline `9c799de1b5cfff16082e65531933e7a249544282`.

#79 consumed R01 exactly once and is settled at [`445c6d7`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/commit/445c6d773ab772cb00f98a274d4bb8fce3e21b84) as **`NOT_DELIVERED / IF`**. Durable Zeroshot run `01a0b7e7-712e-7e42-9e6b-d0d0a2dec6ea` failed after native delivery repeatedly invoked `gh api graphql --paginate --slurp` against the DirectTarget image's GitHub CLI 2.23.0, which does not support `--slurp`. No successful native receipt or Broodling disposition exists. Native delivery did create and update [PR #2](https://github.com/faviann/broodling-p5-v3-20260917/pull/2); that open, unmerged PR, its branch, B1 and observed native commits are retained only as partial-effect evidence, including a verified Git bundle. R01 cannot be rerun or replaced.

V5 cohort accounting remains **`P=8; S=1; D=1; U=1; A=0; J_A=0`**. R02-R08 remain `NOT_STARTED`. #68 remains settled **BLOCKED / NOT RUN** for that cohort because only compatible successful R01 evidence could unlock its remaining slots. V5 cannot support a positive P5 recommendation. #66 may review its retained incomplete package under the existing frozen rules.

Preserve every earlier protocol/evidence package and v5 helper byte, the corrected frozen v5 protocol, settlement at `445c6d7`, partial PR/bundle, quarantined Attempt/store/workspace, stopped container/original image/target state and all prior BLOCKED/NOT RUN provenance. Do not repair, merge, close, resume or reuse the partial PR. Report v5 and v6 separately; never pool their denominators, reset v5 or reinterpret its failure as a later success. Earlier tracker text below is historical context subject to this current gate.

---

## Authority and goal

Follow [the current architecture and P5 plan](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/main/docs/governing/current.md#next-phase-p5-native-workflow-product-evaluation), established by #60 / PR #61. Evaluate the existing thin integration and the quality of its task outcomes; do not inherit the historical v0.5 assurance checklist. This issue records planned work, not a claim that P5 has passed.

## Scope

Use the existing Python boundary to demonstrate criteria-only admission through native submission, durable correlation/reconnection and an actual authorized PR receipt-backed disposition. Independently assess the exact accepted revisions against their frozen task criteria using a small set of valid and meaningfully challenging cases. Reuse current deterministic integration/lifecycle tests instead of recreating native graph tests.

Before live runs, record the compatible product/dependency baseline and establish the current v3 operational prerequisites: a designated disposable GitHub repository/branch with exact PR authority, real Broodling trial inputs, a compatible configured DirectTarget with current provider/delivery credentials, active operator stop capability, and independent exact-revision judging/evidence retention. Automate setup and verification where practical rather than turning those operations into additional Broodling product requirements.

The eight-trial corpus remains bounded and preregistered. There is no P5-specific dollar or wall-time ceiling for these first actively monitored real-provider runs; the owner actively supervises execution and can stop/contain the target. Observed cost/latency remain descriptive evidence where available, not dispatch gates or acceptance thresholds.

## Completion

Retain a reproducible evaluation record distinguishing controlled seam checks, live delivery, real-provider task quality, infrastructure failures and capability gaps. Report observed correct outcomes, false acceptance, unjustified rejection/noncompletion and relevant correction/cost observations, with honest sample limitations and an evidence-backed readiness recommendation for the authorized-PR native profile.

No-effect runs still cannot successfully disposition without a stable local result. All dispatched Attempts remain quarantined against automatic cleanup/replacement. P5 must preserve those limits, not silently fix them with supervision or snapshot machinery. No custom graph/evidence worker/adjudicator/final-assessor protocol, broader effects, new CLI/service or model-tuning campaign is required by this issue.

The superseded #3, #5 and #6 gates are not dependencies. Historical G1–G4 results remain evidence only for their recorded profiles.

---

## Execution tracker — updated 17 September 2026

**Status: #67 settled BLOCKED before admission under v3. No live P5 provider trial has started. P5 verdict: NOT REVIEWED.** The monitored setup produced real fixture/source/Contract/target evidence and identified a concrete missing provider credential route; R01–R08 remain NOT_STARTED. V1/v2 blocked history remains preserved.

### Preserved planning/evidence history

- [x] #63 — Freeze evaluation protocol and record live-run preflight. V1 remains frozen at [`717e94b3548d1dc029bfb54e2758e9929f1d93bd`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/commit/717e94b3548d1dc029bfb54e2758e9929f1d93bd). Before any live result, the decision rules were prospectively refined as `p5-native-pr-v2` at [`1d581717509de182410c3ab2f54d3f65768d8d7f`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/commit/1d581717509de182410c3ab2f54d3f65768d8d7f). V1/v2 remain unchanged provenance.
- [x] #64 — Settled **BLOCKED before admission** at [`b9cacd99beb9a297966e68e6047c7663aca9b4c6`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/commit/b9cacd99beb9a297966e68e6047c7663aca9b4c6). The supported suite passed (330 tests), but B02–B09 under the old preflight were unresolved. R01 was NOT_STARTED; no provider call, PR, receipt or live disposition exists.
- [x] #65 — Settled **BLOCKED / NOT RUN** in the same retained record because #64 did not establish the live boundary. R01–R08 all remained NOT_STARTED; no real-provider quality observation exists.

Those closed issues remain provenance. They are not reopened or relabeled as failures of the product boundary.

### Prospective operational correction

Current live protocol: [`p5-native-pr-v3`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/de1da18479fdf846d04994190132357fcb0a87ef/evaluation/p5/v3/protocol.md), first frozen at [`de1da18479fdf846d04994190132357fcb0a87ef`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/commit/de1da18479fdf846d04994190132357fcb0a87ef). Current governing P5 prerequisites were aligned at [`b8474c4220a6b0a289d954578b9d7c8550de0e64`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/commit/b8474c4220a6b0a289d954578b9d7c8550de0e64).

V3 preserves the v1 corpus/judge and v2 claim-level evidence rules. It changes only operational gating that had grown beyond the current product/evaluation boundary:

- retain the supported baseline, exact authorized disposable PR target, real Broodling per-trial authority/inputs, compatible DirectTarget/current credentials, active stop capability, independent exact-revision judging and durable-enough evidence;
- automate fixture/record/target/evidence setup where practical; setup failures before a slot's first admission may be corrected without consuming the slot;
- remove P5-specific dollar/wall-time ceilings, budget-enforcement/billing-lag/stop-margin gates and formal operator approval signatures;
- relax exhaustive sandbox/package attestations, formal teardown/free-space accounting, separately assigned reviewer/offline judging-host requirements and archive bureaucracy unless a concrete safety/evidence concern makes them material;
- preserve the owner/operator trust boundary, exact effect authorization, no worker access to hidden judging material, serial bounded corpus and quarantine of dispatched Attempts.

The retained B01 suite result from the blocked record may be reused when production/dependency/test tree identity remains applicable; otherwise obtain a fresh supported result. No old blocked item is allowed to silently become a new Broodling MVP requirement.

### Current dependency-ordered work

- [x] #67 — Settled **BLOCKED before admission** in [retained v3 evidence](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/05dee750407988b956d900bcd0a84d2f0e5ae13c/evaluation/p5/runs/2026-09-17-v3-r01/README.md), merged by #70 at `05dee750407988b956d900bcd0a84d2f0e5ae13c`. Setup is automated; no R01 admission or dispatch occurred. Concrete credential-routing follow-up: #69.
- [ ] #68 — **BLOCKED / NOT RUN:** no compatible successful R01 boundary evidence exists. R02–R08 remain NOT_STARTED; do not dispatch through another path.
- [ ] #66 — Skeptically review the resulting v3 evidence (or settled v3 FAIL/BLOCKED package) and record the scoped P5 readiness verdict.

Current disposition: **#67 settled BLOCKED → #68 gated/not run → #66 may review the incomplete v3 package**. A future live-boundary successor requires separately authorized resolution of #69 and compatible prerequisite verification; the still-unstarted R01 slot is not consumed by this setup record. Do not reinterpret the preserved blocked record as a later pass.

### Monitored v3 result from #67

[Evidence package](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/05dee750407988b956d900bcd0a84d2f0e5ae13c/evaluation/p5/runs/2026-09-17-v3-r01/README.md): private disposable `faviann/broodling-p5-v3-20260917`, target branch `p5-eval` at frozen B1, real R01 issue/source/Work Unit/criteria-only Contract, and isolated DirectTarget setup were prepared. Reused B01 is applicable (330 tests passed, zero skips); exact production/test/dependency identities and installed SDK/native bytes match. The target started, returned an empty run inventory, and was externally stopped; the copied auth file was removed.

The [non-secret reproducer](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/blob/05dee750407988b956d900bcd0a84d2f0e5ae13c/evaluation/p5/v3/verify_provider_auth.py) shows the installed selected runtime requires `openai: [OPENAI_API_KEY]`, while Broodling's explicit PR SDK environment supplies no provider key and suppresses an ambient one. DirectTarget has no managed-connection/local-login fallback on this path. This blocks v3 prerequisite 4; #69 records the separately scoped product defect. No production changes, provider substitutions or manual PR handoffs were made.

Counts: `P=8; S=D=U=A=J_A=0`. All slots remain NOT_STARTED; no live outcome class or quality judgment exists. The live receipt/reconnection/disposition and quality claims remain unobserved. Setup completion and issue closure do not establish P5 success. #66 has not yet reviewed this package.

### Measurement rules that remain frozen

The corpus remains eight serial trials (four tasks, two repetitions), all criteria-only, with exact-receipt judging and all-started accounting. R01 remains the boundary trial and counts once. No provider substitutions, extra boundary runs, replacement of dispatched Attempts or rerun-until-green are permitted.

`p5-native-pr-v2` removed `7/8 CO` as an independent quantitative threshold. Raw counts/fractions remain descriptive. The positive gate is claim-level: supported-suite and live-boundary evidence must pass; all eight frozen slots must be accounted for with determinate judgments; every task must have a correct observation; false acceptance is disqualifying; unresolved infrastructure/capability/indeterminate/legitimate-refusal observations cannot be hidden; and at most one isolated unjustified noncompletion may remain only when the paired repetition for that task is correct. These are bounded evidence rules, not a reliability estimate.

### Shared execution and change limits

Zeroshot continues to own standard workflow execution/review/repair and authorized native delivery. Broodling retains admission, current Attempt/run authority, exact effect authorization, receipt validation and lifecycle disposition. Preserve no-effect stable-local-result refusal and quarantine of all dispatched Attempts. Independent judging is evaluation-only; external stop/teardown cannot grant cleanup/replacement authority.

The v3 issues may retain evaluation documentation/evidence and minimal evaluation-only setup/driving support. They do not authorize production redesign, generic refactoring, dependency/model tuning, custom graph/evidence/adjudicator/final-assessor/supervisor machinery, broader effects or new packaging. A concrete product defect discovered by a trial gets a retained reproducer and separately justified follow-up rather than a hidden prerequisite phase.

Update this tracker with #66's reviewed scope, evidence links, explicit verdict and remaining blockers. Do not close it as a successful P5 solely because child issues have reports or the controlled suite is green.


</details>

Accordingly, #71 has been settled **BLOCKED / NOT RUN before R01 admission**. R01 remains unconsumed and all P5 live counts remain zero. This is a profile-selection pause, not a failed provider task.

Current dependency order is now:

The single next execution task is #79: run R01 once against this exact profile after the alignment lands and its freeze/baseline identities are recorded. #68 remains gated until #79 supplies compatible successful R01 boundary evidence. Do not run R01 as part of the alignment work.

The V1 profile alignment described above has landed through PR #80 at `3cc6a772d74f0a18b264a0e0fcefb99f39e0ff6e` on `main`. That commit is the `p5-native-pr-v4` freeze identity. #79 remains the sole next execution task; R01-R08 remain NOT_STARTED, and #68 remains gated on compatible successful R01 boundary evidence.

### P5 v5 R01 settled: blocked on demonstrated DirectTarget infrastructure failure

#79 consumed R01 exactly once and is settled at [`445c6d7`](https://github.com/faviann/broodling/commit/445c6d773ab772cb00f98a274d4bb8fce3e21b84) with primary class **`IF`**. This v5 cohort cannot support a positive P5 recommendation and R01 cannot be rerun or replaced. #68 is therefore settled BLOCKED / NOT RUN for this cohort. #66 may review the retained incomplete package under the existing rules.
